PR: Tracing: elide small traces for Stats call [closed; labels size/M] **What this PR does / why we need it**: At work I see a lot of traces getting data dropped due to being tens of megabytes in size. Looking at what was captured, I see many many repeats of these four spans: Events on the parent trace are cheaper and, for small operations like this, just as useful. Where there was an event line I added a `function` field matching the previous span name. For

`storeEntry.Stats()` I didn't add an event line as it doesn't seem to do very much.
But please correct me; I'm not hugely familiar with the Loki codebase.
